headline.zh: 亚洲首家CASA LAVAZZA文化之家
headline.en: Asia's first CASA LAVAZZA coffee cultural house

traits.zh: 设专业手冲操作台，配备全球仅60台的37号老鹰咖啡机
traits.en: Features a professional pour-over station and the rare #37 Eagle espresso machine (one of only 60 worldwide)

traits.zh: 供应上海限定拼配豆及‘橙力香草籽雪克美式’等健康饮品
traits.en: Serves Shanghai-exclusive blend and health-focused drinks like Orange Energy Vanilla Seed Shaker Americano

traits.zh: 增设舒适靠窗座位，划分下午茶休憩与沙龙区域
traits.en: Offers comfortable window-side seating and designated areas for afternoon tea and salons

traits.zh: 立体咖啡豆展示墙分层陈列生豆至深度烘焙豆
traits.en: Three-tiered coffee bean wall displays green, medium-roast, and dark-roast beans

focus.zh: 有靠窗座位但未提电源/网络
focus.en: Window seats provided but no mention of power or Wi-Fi

linger.zh: 明确打破‘站着喝’模式，设休憩与沙龙区
linger.en: Explicitly designed for lingering with dedicated rest and salon zones

adventure.zh: 上海限定豆、雪克美式、手冲台、多层烘焙豆展示
adventure.en: Shanghai-exclusive blend, shaker Americano, pour-over station, and multi-roast bean display
